tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// bla ma mchod pa'i lhan thabs dbang chog dang bcas pa bzhugs so//

༄༅// thos tshe yid dga' mthong na lta brod pa// btud kyin yi kha rdzogs pa'i rje bcun zhabs// yongs 'du'i dpal lam bsam 'phel nor bu'i mthu// ji bzhin lham mer ngom la phyag 'tshal lo// zhal sgor ma lus rgyud sde'i gsang tshig rnams// 'dab brgya'i ngos la sbrang rtsi ltar chags pa// bung ba bzhin du myang la grub rigs kun// bsod nams chen po'i mkha' la thogs med lding*// 'dir rje btsun bla ma dam pa mchod pa'i cho ga rgyas pa la 'jug par 'dod pas thog mar/ rnal 'byor gyi yo byad kun bsags te bde ba'i stan la 'dug nas/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma sangs rgyas chos kyi sku la skyabs su mchi'o// bla ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la skyabs su mchi'o// bla ma thugs rje sprul pa'i sku la skyabs su mchi'o/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes gsum sogs ji ltar rigs pa bzlas nas/ sems can thams cad mi bzad pa'i sdug bsngal dang bral nas mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa la dgod pa'i phyir/ bla ma rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub pa la 'jug par bya'o snyam du smon pa dang*/ 'jug pa'i sems bskyed pa 'di ltar du bya te/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig /sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig /sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /bde sdug gi rgyu chags sdang nye ring dang bral ba'i btang snyoms chen po la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig/ ces tshangs pa'i gnas pa yid dang 'dre bar bsgoms nas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa nyid e yig gi rang bzhin yongs su gyur pa'i chos 'byung 'byung ba rim brtsegs ri rab pad+ma rwa gur dang bcas pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje'i gzhir/ ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin gyi gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi dang ldan pa/

'dod snam/ pha gu dra ba dra phyed/ shar bu/ bya 'dab/ pu shu/ dbus 'phyur bu rin po che'i tog gis brgyan pa pad+ma la gnas pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo ri dwags gdugs la sogs pas spras pa'i nang sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma lnga pa'i lte ba la seng ge chen po brgyad kyis bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri pad+ma zla nyi brtsegs pa'i gdan la/ rang gi sems rgyu dus kyi bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' thog ma dang mtha' ma med pa'i kun tu bzang po brtan g.yo thams cad kyi khyab bdag tu gyur pa de nyid thugs rje chen po'i dbang gis khams gsum gyi srid pa na 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i phyir/ hūm̐ yig gis sprul pa'i 'bras bu'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang rigs thams cad kyi bdag po lta bas cho ga mi shes par mdzes pa mtshan dpes spras pa'i sku in+d+ra ni la bcag pa'i 'phro ltar sngo ba/ shin tu zhi zhing 'dzum pa ral pa'i zur phud la sna tshogs rdo rje dang zla ba phyed pa 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i cod pan la sogs pa'i rgyan dang phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa dar gyi stod g.yogs dang sham thabs can rdo rje snyems ma dmar mo mdzes sdug gi phul du byon pa bcu drug pa'i lang tsho can phyogs kyi gos ma phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing gri thod 'dzin pa la rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa'i phyag dag gi 'khyud de rdo rje skyil mo krung gis 'od kyi 'phreng ba 'khrigs pa'i dbus na bzhugs par gyur/ mdun gyi 'dab ma nas g.yas skor du gyad dang*/ glang po che dang rta dang rma bya dang*/ shang shang gis bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri pad nyi'i gdan la gtso bo'i sku las 'phros pa'i oṃ yig las rnam par snang mdzad yab yum dkar po/ hūm̐ las mi bskyod pa yab yum sngon po/ traṃ las rin 'byung yab yum ser po/ hriḥlas 'od dpag med yab yum dmar po/ a las don grub yab yum ljang khu/ yab rnams rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas/

yum gri thod thogs pa la 'khyud pa 'khor los sgyur ba bzhin rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan nas gtso bo la 'dud pa'i tshul gyis rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'o// lha de thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥthugs kar hūm̐/ de dag las 'od 'phros/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor mas bskor ba'i ye shes kyi 'khor lo steng gi nam mkhar pheṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdam tshig gi 'khor lo dang gnyis su med par gyur/ snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la hūm̐ bsgoms nas/ oṃ badz+ra gu ru ḍā ki ni sid+dha hūm̐/ zhes bzla/ mos na phra thig gi rnal 'byor kyang bsgom/ rdo rje lag tu blangs te/ hūm̐/ rdo rje gsor ba mdzes pa ste/ dril bu blangs te/ āḥshes rab thabs kyi cho ga 'di// mnyam par sbyar ba'i phyag rgya byas te/ ā li kā li mnyam sbyor ba'i// zhes dam tshig gsum dran pa nas gzung*/ de nas bgegs gtor oṃ gyis sbyangs/ āḥyid dang mthun par mang por spel/ hūm̐ gis sbar bar bsams nas/ oṃ ā kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dha rma ṇāṃ ād+ya nut+pan+na twata oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis bsngos/ hūm̐/ nga ni dpal ldan snying rje'i stobs/ nas/ oṃ suṃ bha ni suṃ bha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛ h+ṇa gṛ h+ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa pa ya gṛh+ṇa pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya hoḥbha ga wan bi d+ya rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bskrad/ 'og thams cad rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ steng thams cad rdo rje'i gur dang bla bre/ logs thams cad rdo rje'i rwa ba dang dra ba/ phyi rol thams cad me ri kha dog rnam pa lngas yongs su bskor bar gyur/ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa/ oṃ swa bhā was mchod pa rnams bsangs/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra puṣ+pe hū ྃ sogs brjod cing kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin du bsam/ de nas ras bris swa bhā was sbyangs/ mdun gyi nam mkhar stong pa nyid e yig gi rang bzhin nas/ steng gi nam mkha' pheṃ

zhes pa'i bar rang gi sems zhes bzhag pa tsam min pa sngar bzhin la de nas spos 'thul zhing dril bu 'khrol la/ hūm̐/ 'gro mgon thugs rje'i spyan ldan rnams/ badz+ra āṃ ku sha dzaḥbadz+ra pā sha ham̐'u/ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ badz+ra a be sha ya hoḥdam tshig pa dang bsre/ thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis dbang gi lha tshogs spyan drangs/ de rnams kyis rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsis gang bas mdun bskyed kyi lha la dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil ba las gtso 'khor thams cad la rdo rje sems dpa' dkar pos dbu brgyan par gyur/ mgon po 'dir ni byon pa nas/ bla med byang chub myur thob shog/ ces pa'i bar gzhung bzhin maṇ+ḍal sngon du 'gro bas dbang blang*/ tshogs byin gyis rlabs pa nas/ lhag ma btang ba'i bar byas/ bdag blo gti mug rmongs pa'i dbang gyur te/ sogs kyis bzod gsol byas/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha bdag la bstim pa'am bris pa sogs yin na de nyid kyi rnam par bsgyur/ bkra shis brjod par bya'o// de ltar bla ma rigs thams cad kyi bdag po'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mchod pa'i lhan thabs pad+ma dkar pos myang stod blo bde'i gzims khang du sbyar ba thams cad kyis rdo rje 'chang chen po grub par gyur cig dkyil 'khor 'khor lo ma lus pa'i// gtso bo'i gnas bzhugs slob dpon ni// sangs rgyas kun gyis phyag mdzad par// btud de dbang gi cho ga bshad// dbang gi khang bur stegs bu'i khar/ dri'i chu dang bdud rtsi lngas bkang ba'i bum pa dang*/ cod pan dar dpyangs dang*/ rdo rje dril bu la sogs pa'i dbang rdzas/ mchod pa'i yo byad tshogs kyi mchod pa dang bcas pa tshang bar bshams nas/ slob dpon bdag nyid spro bsdu la dmigs pa'i bar gyi rnal 'byor la lhag par gnas pa'i 'og tu/ dri'i chus slob ma bkrus/ maṇ+ḍal phul te/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i phyir lan gsum du gsol ba 'di gdab bo//

sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// slob dpon mgon la skyabs su mchi// gtso bo mkha' 'gro mar bcas pa'i// lha rnams kun la phyag 'tshal lo// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol// oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mig dar bcing*/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pa tā ya mi/ brjod pas rnal 'byor du sems bskyed la/ rdo rje snying khar bzhag nas/ oṃ su ra te sa ma ya staṃ ho sid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ oṃ a khaṃ wī ra hūm̐/ slob ma dkyil 'khor du bcug nas/ slob dpon gyi snying kha nas sku gsung thugs dbyer mi phyed pa'i ye shes 'od zer gyi rnam pa slob ma'i lus la thim pas/ bla ma dang gnyis su med par gyur/ gu gul zla mtshan 'dres pa bsreg cing rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas/ oṃ badz+ra a be shā ya aḥ.a ཿrdo rje spyi bor bzhag nas/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra brjod/ pra tī ts+tsha badz+ra ho sa slob dpon gyi lus la me tog dor bas/ gnas lnga gang du phog pa'i rigs nges par bya'o// pra ti gṛh+ṇa staṃ sa twa ma hā ba la/ zhes pas 'phreng ba gtad/ oṃ āḥhū ྃ gis mig dar dbye/ rig pa'i dbang lnga'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas la// mchod sbyin ji ltar stsal ba ltar// bdag kyang rab tu bskyab pa'i phyir// nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol// slob ma dang dbang rdzas kyi bum chu dri'i chus bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa brjod pas sbyangs te/ pad nyi'i gdan la hūṃ las mi bskyod rdo rje 'chang sku mdog sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan nas skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros/ ye shes pa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdabang rdzas kyi mi bskyod pa 'od du zhu ba bum pa'i bdud rtsir gyur/ dkyil 'khor gyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ rig pa'i lha mo rnams kyis dbang bskur/

dbang yul gyi sems dpa' sems mas bkra shis brjod cing mchod/ las dbang gi khro bo khro mos bgegs skrod par mos pas/ rdo rje chen pos dbang bskur ba// khams gsum kun kyis phyag byas pa/ sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi// gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya// oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca mi/ bum pas dbang bskur zhing bum chu 'thung du gzhug go /cod pan dang slob ma bsangs sbyangs/ pad nyi'i gdan la traṃ las rin 'byung rdo rje 'chang sku mdog ser po nas/ rin 'byung 'od du zhu ba cod pan du gyur nas mos pas/ ral pa'i thor tshugs kyis brgyan pa// sangs rgyas kun gyis bsngags pa yi// rin chen dag gi dbu rgyan dang*// dar dpyangs dbang bskur sbyin par bya/ oṃ rat+na a bhi ṣiñca mi/ mgo bo la bskon/ rdo rje dang slob ma bsangs sbyangs/ pad nyi'i gdan la hrīḥlas snang mtha' rdo rje 'chang sku mdog dmar po nas/ snang mtha' 'od du zhu ba'i rdo rjer gyur/ mos pas/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang*/ de ring khyod la bskur bar bya/ sangs rgyas kun nas rab grub phyir/ rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyis long*/ oṃ pad+ma a bhi ṣiñca mi/ lag pa g.yas par gtad/ dril bu dang slob ma bsangs sbyangs/ pad nyi'i gdan la a las don grub rdo rje 'chang sku mdog ljang kha nas/ /don grub 'od du zhu ba'i dril bur gyur/ sangs rgyas kun gyi dril bu'i dbang*/ de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// sangs rgyas kun tu rab grub phyir// dril bu 'di ni khyod kyis long*/ oṃ karma a bhi shiñca mi/ g.yon par gtad/ slob ma bsangs sbyangs/ pad nyi'i gdan la oṃ las rnam snang rdo rje 'chang sku mdog dkar po// mos pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñca mi/ badz+ra nā ma a bhi ṣe ka ta kye dpal// ming btags/ de rnams kyis phung khams lnga'i dri ma sbyangs shing*/ ma rig pa lnga las bzlog nas rig pa'i ye shes lnga bskyed pas rig pa'i dbang zhes bya'o//

maṇ+ḍal phul/ dpa' bo chen po mi ldog pa'i/ dbang bskur ba ni bdag la stsol/ sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// rtag tu bdag ni slob dpon 'gyur// slob ma bsangs sbyangs/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar khyams su seng ges bteg pa'i khri la rdo rje 'chang rigs thams cad kyi bdag po nas gyur gyi bar sgom du bcug nas/ rdo rje rab gnas rdo rje nyid// che dang dril bu chen po bzung*// de ring rdo rje slob dpon 'gyur// slob ma bsdu ba nyid du gyis/ rdo rje thugs kyi dam tshig dril bu gsung gi dam tshig phyag rgya sku'i dam tshig ste brtul zhugs dam tshig gsum dang mi 'bral ba'i sgo nas sems can gyi don gyis shig /de rnams kyis lus kyi dri ma dag /bum pa'i dbang thob/ lam bskyed rim sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sku rdo rje sprul pa'i sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no// gsang dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ khyab bdag bdag la sman pa dang*// bdag don bdag la thugs brtse'i phyir// sgyu 'phrul dra ba mngon rdzogs pa'i// byang chub ci nas bdag thob mdzod// oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mig dar bcing*/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas sku gsung thugs ye shes rdo rje'i lha tshogs thams cad zhu ba'i bdud rtsi byang chub kyi sems dkar dmar 'dres pa'i thig le pad+mar babs pa lces blangs par mos te/ ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis// byang chub sras rnams dbang bskur ltar// de bzhin byang chub sems rgyun gyis// de ring khyod la dbang skur ro// a ho mahā su kha zhes brjod/ mig dar phye/ des ngag gi dri ma dag gsang ba'i dbang thob/ lam rtsa rlung thig le bsgoms pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu gsung rdo rje longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no// dbang gsum pa'i don du maṇ+ḍal/ gsol gdab/ mig dar bcing ba snga ma bzhin byas/ nas/

slob ma rdo rje 'chang chen por gsal ba la/ bla mas rig ma yongs su dag pa'i rdo rje snyems ma slob ma la spyin te/ lha mo dga' sbyin gnas sbyin ma// sna tshogs gzugs can yid 'ong ma// khyer cig khyer cig sems dpa' che// khyer la mchod pa rtag tu gyis// phyag rgya de dang snyoms par zhugs pas dga' ba dang mchog dga'i mthar/ lhan cig skyes pa'i skad cig ma so so rang gis rig par bya'o/ mig dar phye/ yid kyi dri ma dag shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ pho nya'i lam bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu thugs rdo rje chos kyi sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas pa'o// dbang bzhi pa'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol ba gdab/ mig dar bcings nas/ ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing*/ rdo rje nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu// rdul bral mthar phyin zhi ba nyid// khyod rang yang ni de yi pha// zhes dbang bzhi pa'i ye shes bshad/ mig dar phye/ lus ngag yid tha dad du 'dzin pa'i dri ma dag dbang bzhi pa thob/ lam phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ye shes rdo rje ngo bo nyid kyi sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas pa'o// de nas/ khyod kyis srog chags gsad par bya/ rdzun gyi tshig kyang smra bar bya// ma byin pa yang khyod kyis long*// gzhan gyi bud med bsten par gyis

zhes dam tshig dbog gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ bza' btung byin gyis rlabs nas/ bdud rtsi sngon du 'gro bas sha la sogs pa'i bza' ba dang btung ba longs spyod de/ lhag gtor btang*/ dkyil 'khor bsdus nas dag pa gsum pa'i rnal 'byor la gnas par bya'o// slob ma kun spangs la thams cad tshig tsam gyis sbyin pas rung ngo*// bla ma dam pa'i zhal skyin pad+ma dkar pos kho mthing lha khang du sbyar ba dge legs rgyas par gyur cig// / bdag bskyed mdun bskyed mchod bstod rdzogs pa'i bar bsgrubs nas bum bskyed la 'jug cing*/ de yang rnam rgyal dang de'i steng du rnam rgyal chen po thod pa'am dung chos las thams cad pa'i bum pa/ dang po gnyis su phyi ye shes kyi bum pa dang thod pa mtshan nyid thams cad tshang ba nang yangs pa'i 'og gi cha bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho/ de'i dbus su pad+ma'i sdong po la lha tshogs mdun skyed bzhin bskyed pa dang rgyas btab kyi bar bya/ de nas yan lag brgyad ldan sogs kyis mchod bstod/ bzlas pas bskul te sngags gzungs thag la 'khril ba/ rnam rgyal chen po'i lha'i thugs khar phog de 'od du zhu ba'i rgyun bum pa'i lha la thim pas bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du zhu ba dang*/ las thams cad pa la ni zhal bzhi pa'i sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pas chog go// /bkra shis/// /
